headline: PLAICRAFT S1: the clap gate now refuses to launder its own failure signature
lede: Session 342 slot a shipped the 2026-11-18 audit fix on #1711: a red clap pair whose offset sits within one opus frame of the take's own drift is flagged RED as the realtime-stamp signature (audio stamped on wall clock instead of the frame clock) instead of skipped as jitter, machine evidence for line 3 is witness-only from now on, and the store's audio flag means bytes — not a voice section. Probe matrix + working fix route (fake-file capture, 113 KB verified) filed as #2709; claptestplay/voicedrive-shaped suites suspect, check the nightly runner's Chrome too.

Found by the break: a take with a voice section but zero track bytes listed audio:true in the admin view. sessionMeta now derives audio from tracks.length>0 (prod + relaysim share core.js). No stored row retroactively moves — 14/14 live takes carry bytes.

#1711 stays open with next, lines 1/2/4 hold; line 3 hardware-gated twice: Jon's phone take (jonq #2652, deadline Nov 20) and this Mac's witness runs (blocked by #2709). Store sweep claim-to-close: nothing new to grade.
